newsitem.title: UK: Refuge postpones EGM until Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: Refuge postpones EGM until Oct 16.

text.p: Refuge Group Plc, which is seeking to merge with United Friendly Group Plc said on Monday that it was postponing its extraordinary general meeting to approve the merger until October 16 from September 26.

The postponement will allow time for insurer Refuge and its advisers to "explore effective ways in which the new security might operate," said the company in a statement. It added that documents outlining proposals on the security will be sent to shareholders before September 30.
The proposed merger has caused some disquiet among several major Refuge investors who are wavering on whether to back it.
